role.zh: Magic.dev 联合创始人兼 CEO

why.en: Working on ultra-long context and code generation, and drew attention for research aimed at context windows measured in hundreds of millions of tokens.
why.zh: 主攻超长上下文与代码生成，以亿级 token 上下文窗口的研究方向获得关注。

title.en: Magic's counterintuitive approach to pursuing AGI
title.zh: Magic 追求 AGI 的反直觉路径

title.en: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
title.zh: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety

note.en: Cross-lab position paper arguing that chain-of-thought monitoring is a real but fragile safety opportunity; he is one of 43 authors alongside researchers from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic and Apollo.
note.zh: 跨实验室的立场论文，论证思维链监控是一个真实但脆弱的安全机会；他是 43 位作者之一，合著者来自 OpenAI、Google DeepMind、Anthropic 与 Apollo 等机构。

title.en: Founder Eric Steinberger on Magic’s Counterintuitive Approach to Pursuing AGI
title.zh: Founder Eric Steinberger on Magic’s Counterintuitive Approach to Pursuing AGI

note.en: Sequoia interview on Magic's deliberately counterintuitive route to AGI, built around very long context rather than larger training runs.
note.zh: 接受红杉资本访谈，谈 Magic 刻意反直觉的通用人工智能路线——押注超长上下文而非更大规模的训练。

title.en: Building toward a bright post-AGI future with Eric Steinberger from Magic.dev
title.zh: Building toward a bright post-AGI future with Eric Steinberger from Magic.dev

note.en: No Priors interview on building a coding model that behaves like a colleague rather than an autocomplete, and on his optimism about a post-AGI world.
note.zh: 做客 No Priors，谈如何打造一个像同事而非自动补全的编程模型，以及他对后通用人工智能世界的乐观看法。

note.en: His well-known pre-Magic.dev work on Single Deep CFR, a scalable counterfactual-regret-minimization algorithm for imperfect-information games like poker.
note.zh: 他在创立Magic.dev之前的知名研究——Single Deep CFR,一种可扩展的反事实遗憾最小化算法,用于扑克等不完全信息博弈。

title.en: Magic.dev CEO Eric Steinberger on making developers bionic | E1744
title.zh: Magic.dev CEO Eric Steinberger on making developers bionic | E1744

note.en: A This Week in Startups interview in which he explains Magic.dev's approach to making developers 'bionic' with code-generating models.
note.zh: 他在This Week in Startups的访谈中，讲解了Magic.dev如何用代码生成模型让开发者“仿生化”。

title.en: Free Online Learning For Climate Education: Eric Steinberger
title.zh: Free Online Learning For Climate Education: Eric Steinberger

posts.source: The Energy Talk - Storytellers of Afri…

note.en: Interview about ClimateScience, the free climate-education platform he co-founded before Magic.
note.zh: 访谈介绍他在创办 Magic 之前联合创立的免费气候教育平台 ClimateScience。

title.en: Eric Steinberger und die Mission Weltrettung
title.zh: Eric Steinberger und die Mission Weltrettung

note.en: German-language Austrian tech interview from his ClimateScience years, including his contrarian case for nuclear power.
note.zh: 他在 ClimateScience 时期接受的奥地利科技媒体德语访谈，其中包括他支持核能的非主流立场。

title.en: DREAM: Deep Regret minimization with Advantage baselines and Model-free learning
title.zh: DREAM: Deep Regret minimization with Advantage baselines and Model-free learning

note.en: DREAM, a model-free deep reinforcement learning algorithm that converges to Nash equilibrium in two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games.
note.zh: 提出 DREAM，一种无模型的深度强化学习算法，可在两人零和不完全信息博弈中收敛到纳什均衡。

note.en: Single Deep CFR, his solo paper removing the need for full game-tree traversals in counterfactual regret minimization.
note.zh: 独著论文 Single Deep CFR，去除了反事实遗憾最小化中对完整博弈树遍历的依赖。

title.en: Series C company; $466M raised across four rounds
title.zh: C 轮公司；四轮累计融资 4.66 亿美元

body.en: Roughly 109 employees as of April 2026. Founded 2022 with Sebastian De Ro.
body.zh: 截至 2026 年 4 月约 109 名员工。2022 年与 Sebastian De Ro 共同创立。
